status: pre-training qualification protocol; no teacher or student result yet
task: Deterministic role permutation of an explicit sentence; score response bytes only
qualification_categories: Each axis crossed with each operation, six categories; none may be pooled away
training_loss: CE on response bytes only; prompt is context, not a prediction target
baselines: byte n-gram orders 1,4,8,16 fitted on training only
nearest-training-prompt retrieval with fixed Levenshtein distance and lexical tie-breaking
GRU approximately parameter-matched to teacher with identical updates, data order, optimizer settings and seeds
retrieval_metric: Exact response accuracy; deterministic retrieval has no calibrated CE and must not be assigned an arbitrary finite log loss
generation: Greedy autoregressive response from full prompt until newline or 64 bytes; no ground-truth response prefix and no vocabulary restriction
selection: Fixed final checkpoint, zero hyperparameter search trials; evaluate every teacher seed and gate the prespecified aggregate, never choose a lucky seed
gate_sequence: Screen on validation, then one locked qualification split only if validation passes; both must pass every category before any MaleCNS student launches
student_test: Separate untouched composition pairs, not the teacher qualification split; student evaluation protocol must be frozen before student training
failure_policy: If teacher gate fails, report failure and do not launch MaleCNS distillation; revise only as a new versioned experiment
interpretation: Gate values chosen before G2b results; a qualified teacher supports a transfer experiment, not a biological-topology claim
